Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing community colleges to deduct certain payments from tuition waivers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to tuition waivers for community collegeapprenticeship programs; and adding a new section to chapter 28B.50RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28B.50 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: With regard to waivers for courses offered for the purpose ofsatisfying related or supplemental educational requirements forapprentices registered with the Washington state apprenticeship councilor the federal bureau of apprenticeship and training, colleges maydeduct the tuition owed from training contracts with apprenticeorganizations.
